title: rosa pouzinii var. tendae
intro: Rosa pouzinii var. tendae, commonly known as Rosa Tendae, is a species of rose that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is known for its fragrant flowers and is used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall health. The bioactive constituents of Rosa Tendae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health.
